mapper.select:
SELECT m.id,m.username,coalesce(p.display_name,m.username) AS display_name,m.email,m.status,p.department_id,p.position_id
AND m.status='active'
AND m.id::text IN #{id} AND p.department_id::text IN #{id} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_departments d WHERE d.scope_key=#{scope} AND d.id=p.department_id AND d.enabled) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_member_roles mr JOIN nw_foundation_roles r ON r.scope_key=mr.scope_key AND r.id=mr.role_id AND r.enabled WHERE mr.scope_key=#{scope} AND mr.member_id=m.id AND mr.role_id::text IN #{id})
ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 10001
SELECT scope_key FROM nw_foundation_access_scopes WHERE scope_key=#{scope} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_access_scopes(scope_key,tenant_id) VALUES(#{scope},#{tenantId}) ON CONFLICT(scope_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT authorization_version FROM nw_foundation_access_scopes WHERE scope_key=#{scope}
SELECT FROM nw_foundation_departments WHERE scope_key=#{scope} ORDER BY code
SELECT FROM nw_foundation_departments WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_departments SET name=#{row.name},parent_id=#{row.parentId},enabled=#{row.enabled},lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_by_id=#{actorId} WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{row.id} AND lock_version=#{row.lockVersion}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_foundation_departments WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id} AND lock_version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_foundation_positions WHERE scope_key=#{scope} ORDER BY code
SELECT FROM nw_foundation_positions WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_positions SET name=#{row.name},enabled=#{row.enabled},lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_by_id=#{actorId} WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{row.id} AND lock_version=#{row.lockVersion}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_foundation_positions WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id} AND lock_version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT mr.member_id,mr.role_id,r.code FROM nw_foundation_member_roles mr JOIN nw_foundation_roles r ON r.scope_key=mr.scope_key AND r.id=mr.role_id WHERE mr.scope_key=#{scope} AND mr.member_id IN #{id} ORDER BY r.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_member_profiles(scope_key,member_id,display_name) VALUES(#{scope},#{memberId},#{displayName}) ON CONFLICT(scope_key,member_id) DO NOTHING
